title: Character homebrew
description: A character's own content and rules additions: a small pack that belongs to the character, built on the packs it pins. Engines load it as a last pack with the reserved ID `homebrew`, which depends on every pinned pack in pin order, so its definitions are `homebrew:<id>` and its references resolve in the homebrew first, then in the pinned packs. It may not override or hide pinned packs' content, nor change settings (`homebrew-not-allowed`). Its size is bounded by the safety limits `maxHomebrewItems` and `maxHomebrewFormulas`.

defaultLanguage.description: The language of the homebrew's own text. Required when `i18n` is present.

rules.description: Rules-level definitions, in the shape of a rules document, without `settings`.

content.description: Content items, each with its own `id` and `type`. `override` items are not allowed.

i18n.description: Translations by language tag, keyed exactly as in a pack's i18n files (`<id>.name`, `fields.<id>.name`). Engines never read them.
